test_runs.selector: Exact cross-project permissions, isolation, ranking, budgets, timeout/cancellation, provenance, schema parity, and two-real-PV integration
negative_cases: Implicit, duplicate, candidate, or unsupported project authority fails closed.
Missing or mismatched permission grants fail closed.
Project and overall budgets cannot starve later explicit authority members.
Incomplete result authority and invalid timeout hierarchy fail closed.

test_runs.selector: Parallel, cross-lane, and cross-project query stack
negative_cases: Cross-project isolation cannot regress deterministic lane fan-out or typed cross-lane joins.
Completion order cannot change any sealed aggregate identity.

test_runs.selector: Lane guidance, reader, lane contract, registry, and packaged-skill integration
negative_cases: The cross-project primitive cannot weaken canonical lane or packaged-skill identities.
Immutable accepted-PV reads remain bounded and read-only.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, schema parse, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check; py_compile; json.tool; git diff --check
negative_cases: Malformed Python, schema JSON, or whitespace cannot pass.
No Git, install, helper, tunnel, candidate, HIL, pointer, or root-spawned subagent action is included.

limitations: Row218 exposes the internal permissioned cross-project primitive only; SDK handler parity remains Row219.
Public skill and MCP routing remains Row221.
The historical TASK_CONTRACT_AMENDED projection regression remains outside this row.
